name: Shadow Boxing

instructions.description: Stand in a comfortable staggered stance with hands up near chin height.
Throw light controlled punches into the air while rotating through the trunk and pivoting the feet as needed.
Stay light on your feet and move around your space with small balanced steps.
Ease the pace down and return to relaxed breathing at the end of the round.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use timed rounds with controlled punch speed.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: March in place while adding slower arm patterns to reduce intensity.

commentsNotes: Do not lock the elbows at the end of punches.
Keep the fists relaxed between strikes.
